function.arguments: {"answer": "The treatment improves the response rate by 0.144, after adjusting for baseline severity, but this estimate may be biased due to unmeasured confounding from other variables such as age, sex, site, and assay batch.", "value": 0.144, "method": "The treatment arm was not randomised and was assigned preferentially to sicker patients, creating a confounding by severity.
